## Request for Issuance of Subpoenas Duces Tecum and Ad Testificandum 
(Rule 21, Sections 1 to 4, Rules of Court; Section 5, Judicial Affidavit Rule)

Plaintiff, through counsel, respectfully states:

1. By Order of September 4, 2026, this Honorable Court set the plaintiff's evidence for October 14, November 4, November 11, December 2 and December 9, 2026, and the defendants' evidence for January 13, February 3, February 10, March 3 and March 10, 2027, "final and intransferable unless the ground for resetting is allowed under the rules."

2. The plaintiff's documentary case rests on registered instruments, notarial records, survey records, permit records and tax records in the custody of public offices. Plaintiff's representative has requested certified copies from several of these offices; some records have been furnished in part and others not at all. The custodians are government officers who are neither witnesses of the adverse party nor hostile witnesses, and plaintiff therefore avails of the subpoena under Section 5 of the Judicial Affidavit Rule and Rule 21 of the Rules of Court.

3. Plaintiff respectfully requests that subpoenas duces tecum and ad testificandum issue to the following custodians, each to appear on **December 2, 2026 at 1:30 in the afternoon**, or on such date as the Court may fix, and to bring the records described, which are described with the particularity the plaintiff can give from the public entries on Transfer Certificate of Title No. T-52540 (Exhibit "B"):

1. **The Register of Deeds for the Province of Camarines Norte, Daet**, or the records custodian of that office: (i) the pages of the Primary Entry Book for **Entry Nos. 2021003235 and 2021003236**, both of November 23, 2021, showing the date, hour and minute of reception, the instruments received, the fees paid and the name of the person presenting them; (ii) the complete registration file of Entry No. 2021003236, including the **Partition-Subdivision Agreement dated March 15, 2017, Doc. No. 402, Page No. 81, Book No. CXXII, Series of 2017, of Notary Public Donald E. Asis**, with every page, signature, acknowledgment and attachment; (iii) the complete registration file of Entry No. 2021003235, including the Special Power of Attorney of Gloria H. Balane in favor of Karen Gay A. Elevado dated September 15, 2021; (iv) the record of the surrender, upon the registration of November 23, 2021, of the owner's duplicate of TCT No. T-52540 issued under Entry No. 2017000693; and (v) if any of the foregoing is not on file, a certification to that effect. _Relevance:_ these records establish who presented the Deed of Absolute Sale of September 29, 2016 and the partition for registration more than four years after the death of the agent who executed them, and whether any of the registered owners executed or consented to the partition on which TCT No. 079-2021002126 was issued.

2. **The Clerk of Court and Ex-Officio Provincial Sheriff, Regional Trial Court, Daet**, or the custodian of notarial records: (i) the notarial register entries and the duplicate originals on file for instruments of **Atty. Donald E. Asis**: Doc. No. 402, Page No. 81, Book No. CXXII, Series of 2017; Doc. No. 115, Page No. 23, Book No. CXXII, Series of 2017; and Doc. No. 304, Page No. 61, Book No. CXVI, Series of 2016, together with the certified monthly entries of Book No. CXXII for March 2017; (ii) the notarial register entries and duplicate originals on file for instruments of **Atty. Elaine Gay R. Belen**: Doc. No. 560, Page No. 112, Book No. XI, Series of 2016, and Doc. No. 55, Page No. 17, Book No. IX, Series of 2012; (iii) the register entry for Doc. No. 019, Page No. 04, Book No. XIV, Series of 2021 of whichever notary public of Daet holds it; (iv) the complete record of **Special Proceeding No. 2156** of Branch 41, including the order of November 2016 in full and the certificate of finality of March 13, 2017; and (v) the complete record of **Civil Case No. 8563** of Branch 41, including the complaint and the Verified Answer received July 9, 2021 with its annexes. _Relevance:_ the register entries show who appeared before the notary and when, for the deed, the confirmation and the partition on which the defendants' title rests; the Special Proceeding record shows what the agent alleged and who was notified; the Civil Case 8563 record shows service, on counsel for the defendants' attorney-in-fact, of the published revocation of the agent's authority before registration.

3. **The Regional Director, Land Management Service, DENR Region V, Legazpi City**, or the custodian of survey records, and **Geodetic Engineer Christopher D. Mangiga**: the complete file of subdivision plan **(LRA) PSD-E2020005406** (Lot 2-X-6-I-4-C, Psd-05-026197, TCT No. T-52540), surveyed September 8, 2020 and approved April 6, 2021, including the survey authority, the application, the identity of the applicant and payor, the owner's consent or authorization relied upon, the field notes and the approval. _Relevance:_ the plan was certified as executed "with the full knowledge and consent of the owner(s)" at a time when none of the registered owners had knowledge of it and the only attorney-in-fact had died on June 21, 2017; the file shows who claimed to act for the owners.

4. **The Building Official, Municipality of Mercedes**, or the records custodian of the Office of the Municipal Engineer: every building permit, application for building permit, approved plan, certificate of occupancy and supporting document for any structure on **Lot 2-X-6-I-4-C or Lot 2-X-6-I-4-C-1, Barangay San Roque, Mercedes**, applied for or issued in the name of Efren Balane, Gloria H. Balane, Princess Balane Torralba, Jomil Torralba, Erwin H. Balane or Ferdinand Balane, from 1975 to date; or a certification that no such permit or application is on file. _Relevance:_ the defendants claim to be builders in good faith entitled to indemnity and retention; a permit application shows what right over the land the applicant claimed and when; the absence of any permit bears on the same claim. Plaintiff's representative requested these records in writing on January 24, 2026 and the request was declined.

5. **The Municipal Assessor, Municipality of Mercedes**: certified copies of Tax Declarations / Assessment of Real Property Nos. **GR-2014-HH-07-001-00246, GR-2014-HH-07-001-00247, GR-2014-HH-07-001-00274 and GR-2014-HH-07-001-00276**, the letter request of September 21, 2021 on which ARP No. 00274 was revised, and every tax declaration of buildings or improvements on Lot 2-X-6-I-4-C or 2-X-6-I-4-C-1 in the name of any of the defendants, showing the declarant, the date of declaration and the assessed value. _Relevance:_ the declarations fix the dates and the values the defendants themselves gave the government for the improvements they now claim, and show the declaration by which the defendant identified the land in her Special Power of Attorney of May 28, 2020.

6. **The Revenue District Officer, BIR Revenue District No. 64, Daet**: the dockets of Electronic Certificates Authorizing Registration **No. 201900074035 dated June 19, 2020 (issued under TCT No. T-38838)** and **No. 201900675224 dated November 18, 2021 (issued under TCT No. T-52540)**, including the application, the identity of the filer, the documents presented and the request for re-issuance. _Relevance:_ the first certificate was issued under a title cancelled in 1999 and the second re-used the same tax payments; the dockets show who processed the dead agent's deed in 2020 and 2021.

7. **The Provincial Treasurer, Province of Camarines Norte**: the record of Official Receipt No. 0585696 dated June 24, 2020 for transfer tax on the Deed of Absolute Sale dated September 29, 2016, with the computation of the surcharge and interest assessed. _Relevance:_ the surcharge and interest establish that the deed was not presented for taxation for about four years after its execution.

8. **The Provincial Prosecutor, Camarines Norte, Daet**: the records of **NPS-V-09-INV-2020F-00383 and NPS-V-09-INV-2020G-00417**, including the counter-affidavit of Nelly H. Juntilla and the letter of counsel dated February 11, 2020 annexed to it. _Relevance:_ the identity of the counsel acting for defendant Gloria H. Balane on this parcel in February 2020, before registration, and the attorney-in-fact's own account of her authority.

9. **The Municipal Fire Marshal, Bureau of Fire Protection, Mercedes; the Camarines Norte Electric Cooperative (CANORECO); and the Punong Barangay, Barangay San Roque, Mercedes**: fire safety inspection certificates, electric service connection records, and barangay clearances for construction, for structures on Lot 2-X-6-I-4-C or 2-X-6-I-4-C-1 in the name of any of the defendants. _Relevance:_ the dates of construction of the improvements claimed.

10. **The Election Officer, COMELEC, Mercedes, and the Secretary to the Sangguniang Bayan, Mercedes**: a certification of the elective positions and terms held by Gloria H. Balane (Barangay Kagawad, 1997 to 2004; Sangguniang Bayan Member, 2004 to 2017, as she has alleged), and a certified copy of Sangguniang Bayan Resolution No. 103-86 dated July 16, 1986 with its attendance. _Relevance:_ the defendants' opportunity to know who owned the land and who administered it.

11. The records requested are relevant to the issues of the authority of the agent who executed the Deed of Absolute Sale of September 29, 2016, the good faith of the defendants up to the registration of November 23, 2021, the validity of the partition on which TCT No. 079-2021002126 was issued, and the defendants' claim to indemnity for improvements, all of which are in issue under the pleadings. They are in the exclusive custody of the offices named. The requests are made now so that the returns are in before the plaintiff's last two settings of December 2 and 9, 2026.

**WHEREFORE**, plaintiff respectfully prays that this Honorable Court issue subpoenas duces tecum and ad testificandum to the custodians named in paragraph 3, commanding them to appear on **December 2, 2026 at 1:30 in the afternoon**, or on such date as the Court may fix, and to bring the records described, and that the plaintiff be allowed to present the custodians and mark the records on that date.

Other reliefs just and equitable are likewise prayed for.

Daet, Camarines Norte, October ___, 2026.

**Note for counsel.** Items (a) and (b) duplicate the certified-copy requests plaintiff's representative is filing directly with the Registry and the Clerk of Court this week; the subpoena is the fallback if those requests are not answered within fifteen days of receipt. Item (d) is the record the Building Official, a defendant, has already declined to release; a subpoena places non-compliance before the Court rather than before any other forum. The returns under items (d) to (i) are what the plaintiff's answer to the twelfth affirmative defense (Articles 448, 546 and 548) depends on.
